inputs.text: Locked camera, full body portrait of the same adult female ship captain from the reference image. Beautiful cel shaded hand-painted Japanese strategy RPG illustration. Preserve her exact facial identity, short black bob, red cape, ivory blouse, black and gold waistcoat, belts, compass, trousers and boots. The warm gray background stays uniform and completely still. Her feet and hands remain in their original positions. Subtle restrained motion, stable silhouette and costume details. She very gently softens her expression into a restrained closed-mouth smile, then relaxes back to her initial expression. One natural blink, almost imperceptible breathing, otherwise still. Her head angle, hands and feet remain unchanged.
